local WALK_SPEED = configNumber("WalkSpeed", 16) local JUMP_POWER = configNumber("JumpPower", 50) local MAX_HEALTH = configNumber("MaxHealth", 100) local RESPAWN_DELAY = configNumber("RespawnDelay", 1) local KILL_Y = configNumber("KillY", -100) local SPAWN_ENTITY_ID = configString("SpawnEntityId", "") local systems = decodeJson(configString("Systems", "{}"), {})
Players.RespawnTime = math.max(0, RESPAWN_DELAY)

local function leaderstatsFor(player) local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats") if not leaderstats then leaderstats = Instance.new("Folder") leaderstats.Name = "leaderstats" leaderstats.Parent = player end ensureInt(leaderstats, "Stage", 0) ensureInt(leaderstats, "Collectibles", 0) ensureInt(leaderstats, "Score", 0) ensureInt(leaderstats, "Wins", 0) ensureNumber(leaderstats, "Time", 0) ensureNumber(leaderstats, "BestTime", 0) return leaderstats end

local collectible = component(data, "collectible") if collectible then part.Touched:Connect(function(hit) local _, humanoid, player = characterFromHit(hit) if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or not player then return end local collectibleId = tostring(collectible.collectibleId or data.id) local playerCollected = collectedByPlayer[player] if not playerCollected then playerCollected = {} collectedByPlayer[player] = playerCollected end if playerCollected[collectibleId] then return end local collection = { model = model } playerCollected[collectibleId] = collection local leaderstats = leaderstatsFor(player) local collectibleValue = math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(collectible.value) or 1)) leaderstats.Collectibles.Value += 1 leaderstats.Score.Value += collectibleValue collectibleVisuals:FireClient(player, model, true)
local respawnSeconds = tonumber(collectible.respawnSeconds) if respawnSeconds then task.delay(math.max(0, respawnSeconds), function() if not player.Parent or not model.Parent then return end local values = collectedByPlayer[player] if not values or values[collectibleId] ~= collection then return end values[collectibleId] = nil collectibleVisuals:FireClient(player, model, false) end) end end) end

for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do setupPlayer(player) end Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(setupPlayer) Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player) collectedByPlayer[player] = nil startedAt[player] = nil finishTimes[player] = nil respawnPositions[player] = nil end)
task.spawn(function() while task.wait(0.1) do for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do local character = player.Character local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") if root and root:IsA("BasePart") and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 and root.Position.Y < KILL_Y then humanoid.Health = 0 end
local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats") local timeValue = leaderstats and leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Time") if systems.timer and systems.timer.enabled == true and player:GetAttribute("BoxilyFinished") ~= true and timeValue and timeValue:IsA("NumberValue") then local elapsed = math.max(0, os.clock() - (startedAt[player] or os.clock())) if systems.timer and systems.timer.enabled == true and systems.timer.mode == "count-down" then elapsed = math.max(0, (tonumber(systems.timer.durationSeconds) or 0) - elapsed) end timeValue.Value = math.floor(elapsed * 10) / 10 end end end end)

genreControl:FireClient(player, "crop", entry.model, "empty", 0) end if producer then genreControl:FireClient(player, "producer", entry.model, producer.startsOwned == true) end end for _, entry in ipairs(vehicles) do local occupant = entry.seat.Occupant if occupant and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(occupant.Parent) == player then occupant.Sit = false entry.speed = 0 entry.model:PivotTo(entry.origin) end end if replay and restoreEnemies then local othersPlaying = false for _, other in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do if other ~= player and other:GetAttribute("BoxilyFinished") ~= true then othersPlaying = true break end end if not othersPlaying then restoreEnemies() end end end local function makePrompt(entry, label, callback) local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt") prompt.Name = "BoxilyInteraction" prompt.ActionText = label prompt.ObjectText = entry.model.Name prompt.KeyboardKeyCode = Enum.KeyCode.E prompt.HoldDuration = 0 prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 9 prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = false prompt.Parent = entry.part prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player) -- Prompt settings are client editable. Check range/alive/completion on -- the server before every resource transaction. if player:GetAttribute("BoxilyFinished") == true or not nearby(player, entry, 11) then return end local state = stateFor(player) local previous = state.cooldowns[entry.data.id] or -math.huge if os.clock() - previous < 0.2 then return end state.cooldowns[entry.data.id] = os.clock() callback(player, state) syncProgress(player) end) end
for _, model in ipairs(world:GetChildren()) do if model:IsA("Model") then local metadata = model:FindFirstChild("__Boxily") local value = metadata and metadata:FindFirstChild("Data") local primary = model.PrimaryPart if value and primary then local data = decode(value.Value, {}) local entry = { model = model, primary = primary, part = model:FindFirstChild("Hitbox", true) or primary, data = data, origin = model:GetPivot() } table.insert(entries, entry) local checkpoint = component(data, "raceCheckpoint") if checkpoint then highestRaceGate = math.max(highestRaceGate, checkpoint.index) entry.raceCheckpoint = checkpoint table.insert(raceGates, entry) end local interaction = component(data, "interaction") if interaction then makePrompt(entry, tostring(interaction.label or "Interact"), function(player, state) if interaction.oneShot == true and state.used[data.id] then message(player, "Already completed") return end local now = os.clock() if now - (state.used[data.id] or -math.huge) < (interaction.cooldownSeconds or 0.5) then return end for _, flag in ipairs(interaction.requiresFlags or {}) do if not state.flags[flag] then message(player, "Complete the earlier objective first") return end end if not transact(state, interaction.costs, interaction.rewards) then message(player, "Not enough resources") return end for _, flag in ipairs(interaction.setsFlags or {}) do state.flags[flag] = true end state.used[data.id] = now message(player, interaction.label or "Completed") interactionEvent:Fire(player, data.id) end) end local crop = component(data, "crop") if crop then makePrompt(entry, "Plant / harvest", function(player, state) local result, seconds = useCrop(state, crop, data.id, os.clock()) if result == "planted" then genreControl:FireClient(player, "crop", model, "growing", crop.growSeconds) message(player, "Planted! Ready in " .. tostring(crop.growSeconds) .. "s") interactionEvent:Fire(player, data.id) elseif result == "harvested" then genreControl:FireClient(player, "crop", model, "empty", 0) message(player, "Harvested +" .. tostring(crop.yieldAmount) .. " " .. tostring((definitions[crop.resourceId] or {}).label or crop.resourceId)) interactionEvent:Fire(player, data.id) elseif result == "insufficient" then message(player, "Not enough resources to plant") else message(player, "Growing: " .. tostring(math.ceil(seconds)) .. "s remaining") end end) end local producer = component(data, "producer") if producer then makePrompt(entry, tostring(producer.label or "Buy producer"), function(player, state) if state.producers[data.id] then message(player, "Already producing") return end local costs = producer.costResourceId and { { resourceId = producer.costResourceId, amount = producer.costAmount or 0 } } or {} if not transact(state, costs, {}) then message(player, "Not enough resources to buy") return end state.producers[data.id] = { elapsed = 0 } genreControl:FireClient(player, "producer", model, true) message(player, "Purchased! Production started") interactionEvent:Fire(player, data.id) end) end local goal = component(data, "goal") if goal then hasGoal = true table.insert(declaredGoals, goal) makePrompt(entry, tostring(goal.label or "Complete goal"), function(player, state) if goalsSatisfied(state, declaredGoals) then completeGoal(player, goal) else message(player, "Keep going: the objective is not complete yet") end end) end local vehicle = component(data, "vehicle") if vehicle then local seat = Instance.new("VehicleSeat") seat.Name = "BoxilyDriverSeat" seat.Size = Vector3.new(2, 0.4, 2) seat.CFrame = primary.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, primary.Size.Y / 2 + 0.2, 0) seat.Anchored = true seat.CanCollide = false seat.HeadsUpDisplay = false seat.Parent = model entry.seat = seat entry.speed = 0 entry.vehicle = vehicle table.insert(vehicles, entry) makePrompt(entry, "Drive (WASD, jump to exit)", function(player) local _, humanoid = playerBody(player) if humanoid and not seat.Occupant then seat:Sit(humanoid) end end) end local enemy = component(data, "enemy") if enemy then entry.enemy = enemy entry.health = enemy.maxHealth entry.deadUntil = nil entry.attackTimes = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }) model:SetAttribute("BoxilyEnemyHealth", entry.health) table.insert(enemies, entry) end end end end table.sort(raceGates, function(first, last) return first.raceCheckpoint.index < last.raceCheckpoint.index end)
local function setupPlayer(player) resetPlayer(player) player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function() stateFor(player).previousRacePosition = nil end) player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("BoxilyFinished"):Connect(function() if player:GetAttribute("BoxilyFinished") == false then resetPlayer(player, true) end end) end for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do setupPlayer(player) end Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(setupPlayer) Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player) progress[player] = nil end)
-- Server-only API for intentional extensions. NumberValues are read-only -- mirrors; extensions transact against the authoritative state through this -- bridge so the next HUD sync cannot overwrite an intentional economy change. extensionBridge.OnInvoke = function(action, player, first, second) if typeof(player) ~= "Instance" or not player:IsA("Player") or player.Parent ~= Players then return { ok = false, error = "invalid_player" } end local state = stateFor(player) if action ~= "snapshot" and player:GetAttribute("BoxilyFinished") == true then return { ok = false, error = "run_finished", snapshot = snapshotProgress(state) } end local result = extensionAction(state, action, first, second) syncProgress(player) return result end extensionBridge:SetAttribute("Ready", true)
local function hideEnemy(entry, hidden) for _, part in ipairs(entry.model:GetDescendants()) do if part:IsA("BasePart") then if hidden then part:SetAttribute("BoxilyOriginalTransparency", part.Transparency) part:SetAttribute("BoxilyOriginalCollide", part.CanCollide) part.Transparency = 1 part.CanCollide = false else part.Transparency = part:GetAttribute("BoxilyOriginalTransparency") or 0 part.CanCollide = part:GetAttribute("BoxilyOriginalCollide") == true end end end end restoreEnemies = function() for _, entry in ipairs(enemies) do if entry.deadUntil then hideEnemy(entry, false) end entry.deadUntil = nil entry.health = entry.enemy.maxHealth entry.attackTimes = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }) entry.model:PivotTo(entry.origin) entry.model:SetAttribute("BoxilyEnemyHealth", entry.health) end end genreControl.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, action) if action ~= "attack" or player:GetAttribute("BoxilyFinished") == true then return end local root = playerBody(player) if not root then return end local state = stateFor(player) local now = os.clock() if now - state.attackAt < math.max(0.1, tonumber(combat.cooldownSeconds) or 0.5) then return end state.attackAt = now local nearest = nil local nearestDistance = math.max(1, tonumber(combat.range) or 7) for _, entry in ipairs(enemies) do if not entry.deadUntil then local distance = (entry.primary.Position - root.Position).Magnitude if distance <= nearestDistance then nearest, nearestDistance = entry, distance end end end if not nearest then return end -- Walls block attacks even when a hostile is within the declared range. local rayParams = RaycastParams.new() rayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { player.Character, nearest.model } rayParams.RespectCanCollide = true if workspace:Raycast(root.Position, nearest.primary.Position - root.Position, rayParams) then return end nearest.health = math.max(0, nearest.health - math.max(1, tonumber(combat.damage) or 25)) nearest.model:SetAttribute("BoxilyEnemyHealth", nearest.health) if nearest.health == 0 then state.defeats += 1 if nearest.enemy.rewardResourceId then addResource(state, nearest.enemy.rewardResourceId, nearest.enemy.rewardAmount or 0) end nearest.deadUntil = now + (nearest.enemy.respawnSeconds or math.huge) hideEnemy(nearest, true) syncProgress(player) message(player, "Enemy defeated!") else message(player, "Hit! " .. tostring(nearest.health) .. " health remaining") end end)
local tickElapsed = 0 RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(deltaTime) local dt = math.min(0.1, deltaTime) local now = os.clock() for _, entry in ipairs(vehicles) do local seat = entry.seat local occupant = seat.Occupant local throttle = occupant and math.clamp(seat.ThrottleFloat, -1, 1) or 0 local steering = occupant and math.clamp(seat.SteerFloat, -1, 1) or 0 local wanted = throttle * entry.vehicle.maxSpeed local step = entry.vehicle.acceleration * dt entry.speed += math.clamp(wanted - entry.speed, -step, step) if math.abs(entry.speed) > 0.01 then local pivot = entry.model:GetPivot() local turn = math.rad(entry.vehicle.turnSpeed) * steering * dt * math.clamp(entry.speed / entry.vehicle.maxSpeed, -1, 1) local nextPivot = pivot * CFrame.Angles(0, -turn, 0) * CFrame.new(0, 0, -entry.speed * dt) local rayParams = RaycastParams.new() rayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { entry.model, occupant and occupant.Parent or entry.model } rayParams.RespectCanCollide = true local direction = nextPivot.Position - pivot.Position local clearance = entry.primary.Size.Z / 2 local collision = workspace:Raycast(pivot.Position, direction.Unit * (direction.Magnitude + clearance), rayParams) if collision then entry.speed = 0 else entry.model:PivotTo(nextPivot) end end end for _, entry in ipairs(enemies) do if entry.deadUntil then if now >= entry.deadUntil then entry.deadUntil = nil entry.health = entry.enemy.maxHealth entry.model:PivotTo(entry.origin) entry.model:SetAttribute("BoxilyEnemyHealth", entry.health) hideEnemy(entry, false) end else local target, targetRoot, targetHumanoid = nil, nil, nil local distance = entry.enemy.detectionRadius for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do local root, humanoid = playerBody(player) if root and player:GetAttribute("BoxilyFinished") ~= true then local candidate = (root.Position - entry.primary.Position).Magnitude if candidate < distance then target, targetRoot, targetHumanoid, distance = player, root, humanoid, candidate end end end if targetRoot then if distance <= entry.enemy.attackRange then if now - (entry.attackTimes[target] or -math.huge) >= entry.enemy.attackCooldownSeconds then entry.attackTimes[target] = now targetHumanoid:TakeDamage(entry.enemy.damage) end else local direction = Vector3.new(targetRoot.Position.X - entry.primary.Position.X, 0, targetRoot.Position.Z - entry.primary.Position.Z) if direction.Magnitude > 0.01 and entry.enemy.speed > 0 then local step = direction.Unit * math.min(direction.Magnitude, entry.enemy.speed * dt) local rayParams = RaycastParams.new() rayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { entry.model, target.Character } rayParams.RespectCanCollide = true if not workspace:Raycast(entry.primary.Position, step.Unit * (step.Magnitude + 1), rayParams) then entry.model:PivotTo(entry.model:GetPivot() + step) end end end end end end tickElapsed += deltaTime if tickElapsed < 0.1 then return end local elapsed = tickElapsed tickElapsed = 0 for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do if player:GetAttribute("BoxilyFinished") ~= true then local state = stateFor(player) local root = playerBody(player) if root then for _, entry in ipairs(raceGates) do local gate = entry.raceCheckpoint local inside = withinGate(root.Position, entry) local crossed = crossedGate(state.previousRacePosition, root.Position, entry) local gateKey = "gate:" .. entry.data.id if advanceRace(state, gate, highestRaceGate, crossed and not state.used[gateKey]) then message(player, "Lap " .. tostring(state.laps) .. " / " .. tostring(systems.raceLaps or 3)) end state.used[gateKey] = inside or nil end end for _, entry in ipairs(entries) do local producer = component(entry.data, "producer") local owned = producer and state.producers[entry.data.id] if owned then advanceProducer(state, producer, owned, elapsed) end local goal = component(entry.data, "goal") if goal and root then completeGoal(player, goal) end end if root and highestRaceGate > 0 and not hasGoal and state.laps >= (systems.raceLaps or 3) then completeGoal(player, { label = "Race complete!", conditions = { { type = "race", laps = systems.raceLaps or 3 } } }) end state.previousRacePosition = root and root.Position or nil syncProgress(player) end end end)
